column1: # status PLACEHOLDER: the shipped icon is freegameassets.com Fantasy RPG Icons art, chosen by ability-name theme. It is NOT 6.88g art.
# source_pack_file is the pack icon the shipped file comes from; empty when no source table names it (status UNKNOWN).

# code_688g and art_688g come from 6.88g ability.ini Art (ReplaceableTextures\CommandButtons or PassiveButtons), joined by hy3d ability-match.tsv. They name the 6.88g icon this placeholder stands in for. Empty means no 6.88g ability carries this id (heroes absent from 6.88g, or helper/pulse abilities).

# 6.88g icon PIXELS are not obtainable in this workspace: no 6.88g map archive, MPQ or BLP exists under /workspace/oscraft or /workspace/hy3d (only war3map.j, war3map.w3e and the LNI text exports). Art strings are the whole 6.88g icon record available.
